cond_0001.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience.
Preferred Requirements
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.

cond_0001.values: We value creating outcomes that are useful, fair, and mindful of the people they affect. We aim to approach our work with responsibility and respect.

cond_0022.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of cleaning validation concepts and how they apply across equipment and processes.
cond_0022.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0022.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.
Preferred Requirements
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise.

cond_0043.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation with knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports, and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, and procedures and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0043.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Supporting investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach and procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME point of contact for cleaning validation reviews with Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning, and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments on specific project milestones.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0043.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering, or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.

Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise.

cond_0053.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation with knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer owns preparation of product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports, and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include driving validation activities across departments and leading the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate commands deep knowledge of cleaning validation concepts, practices, and procedures, and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0053.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execute cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Accountable for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Leading investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and delivering documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Directing validation activities with other departments.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0053.requirements:
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience.
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.

Coordinating execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Supporting adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Working with relevant teams to prepare, review, and execute related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.

Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.

Coordinating with the Microbiology Lab on assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.

Supporting development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Performing periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.

Coordinating scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

cond_0164.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0164.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0164.requirements:

Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering, or Chemistry) required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in cleaning validation within a pharmaceutical operation or equivalent setting.

Proven ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.

The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0264.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0264.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry), or equivalent practical experience.
Around five (5) years of cleaning validation experience in a pharmaceutical operation, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Stays current with developments and trends in areas of expertise; a willingness to keep learning is valued.
Ability to write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures, with or without close supervision.

cond_0285.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation with knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports, and procedural documentation. A large part of the role involves coordinating validation activities daily with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, and procedures, and regularly leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0285.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Actively contributing to investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities, and communicating findings through documentation to support the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing hands-on training to staff on the cleaning validation approach and procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for direct presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors, handling questions and walking stakeholders through findings.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Staying in regular contact with other departments to coordinate validation activities.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0285.requirements:
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience.
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.

cond_0296.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation with knowledge of equipment and process validation. You will own the preparation of product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports, and procedural documentation. You will drive coordination of validation activities across departments and take accountability for maintaining cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, you will lead and instruct others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0296.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Own the writing and reviewing of cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintain the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execute cleaning validation protocol activities and direct sample collection.
Ensure adherence to FDA guidance, regulatory requirements, and client Validation Master Plans.
Prepare, review, and execute related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact and equipment surfaces.
Prepare and execute cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Prepare risk assessments and reports summarizing data and determining cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Lead assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Drive investigations, i.e., deviations during protocol execution and/or continuous monitoring activities, and deliver documentation to support investigation findings.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and direct implementation of new cleaning equipment and processes.
Prepare SOPs and deliver training to staff on cleaning validation approach and procedures.
Generate and execute new cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ, and PQ documents.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
Serve as SME and present cleaning validation findings to Regulatory (FDA), internal, and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Schedule, plan, and execute equipment and process qualifications against approved schedules.
Direct validation activities in coordination with other departments.
Apply experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0296.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g., Microbiology, Biology, Engineering, or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation experience in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant field.
Preferred Requirements
Stays current with developments and trends in areas of expertise.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.

cond_0352.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0352.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0352.requirements:
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience.
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.

cond_0455.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with cleaning validation work.
cond_0455.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0455.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.
Preferred Requirements
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise.

cond_0477.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer works with departments and personnel to prepare product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and works alongside others to support and guide cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0477.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Collaborating on writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Working with the team on execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Supporting adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Coordinating preparation, review, and execution of related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development, in coordination with relevant teams.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Working with site teams to assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Coordinating with the Microbiology Lab on assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Supporting development projects when modifications are required and coordinating implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures.
Collaborating on new cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Performing periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
Serving as SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Coordinating scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments.
Working with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0477.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.
Preferred Requirements
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise.

A large part of the role involves coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel daily, and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, and procedures, and actively leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0510.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan.
Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection.
Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans.
Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces.
Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development.
Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation.
Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix.
Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces.
Actively contributing to investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities, and communicating documentation to support the findings of the investigation.
Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes.
Preparing SOPs and providing hands-on training to staff on the cleaning validation approach and procedures.
New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution.
Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies.
SME for presenting cleaning validation findings directly to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors, walking them through data and handling questions.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules.
Coordinating validation activities with other departments on a regular basis.
Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0510.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry).
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience.
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures.
Preferred Requirements
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise.
cond_0510.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0510.workplace_support: We work to create an environment where employees feel supported, heard, and able to do their best work. Our approach includes flexibility, trust, and practical support that helps people thrive across changing needs and responsibilities.
